pre_condition: proj_dir is a path to a directory within a git repository. revision is a valid commit identifier reachable in that repository. file_languages is a dict mapping relative file paths to language key strings.
post_condition: If a git worktree at the given revision can be created and CodeGraph can successfully index the resulting source tree, returns a tuple (functions, coverage) where functions maps each source file path to a dict of function data keyed by function name, and coverage indicates for each file in file_languages which functions were and were not observed by CodeGraph. If worktree creation fails or CodeGraph indexing fails at any point, returns None after logging a warning. In all cases — success, failure, or any exception in between — any temporary worktree and its parent directory created during the call are removed before the function returns, leaving no side effects on the filesystem.
